title: How I Met Your Mother: The Long Con
description: Rom-com chaos and the long tale of how he met their mother.

questions.question: Ted and the gang spend nine seasons in the same booth at what bar below his apartment?
questions.explanation: It's named after Carl MacLaren, an assistant to creator Carter Bays (the bartender is Carl too). The look came from McGee's, a real pub on West 55th Street.

questions.question: At MacLaren's, Barney famously interrupts his favorite word with "wait for it." What is the word?
questions.explanation: The word even got its own pun of an episode title: "Legendaddy" (Season 6), when Barney finally meets his father, Jerry, played by John Lithgow.

questions.question: Barney's most legendary schemes, like "The Lorenzo Von Matterhorn" and "Mrs. Stinsfire," are written down in what book?
questions.explanation: It debuted in "The Playbook" (Season 5), where Barney backs up the Lorenzo con with fake websites. A real tie-in book, credited to Barney Stinson, followed in 2010.

questions.question: Barney "burns" his Playbook in Season 8, but its secret final page holds his longest con: a 16-step play to win back his future bride. What is the play called?
questions.explanation: Even his fake romance with Patrice and the Playbook bonfire were steps. She finds the page on the WWN rooftop; Step 16 is on the back: "Hope she says yes."

questions.question: After "The Robin," one Barney mystery remains: whenever asked about his job, he just says "Please." What does P.L.E.A.S.E. stand for?
questions.answer: Provide Legal Exculpation And Sign Everything
acceptedAnswers: Provide Legal Exculpation And Sign Everything
provide legal exculpation and sign everything
choices: Prepare Lawsuits, Evade Audits, Shred Evidence
Process Leases, Expedite Accounts, Settle Escrow
Protect Legacy Executives And Silence Employees
questions.hint: It's literally what P.L.E.A.S.E stands for
questions.explanation: Revealed in "Unpause" (Season 9): Barney is the fall guy who signs off on shady deals while secretly helping the feds take down Greg, the boss who stole his girlfriend.
